In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a '''3D-4X administrative droid''' was in the service of [[Mentis Qinx]], who owned a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] encountered a young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who was masquerading as his father, [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].
